read_document: read a PDF or Word document and return its text content with optional line truncation
cat_file: read the contents of a file in the sandboxed file system and return as text or bytes
create_directory: create a new directory in the sandbox with optional parent directory creation
list_directory: list the contents of a directory in the sandbox with optional detailed file information
generate_tree: generate a string representing the directory and file structure in a tree format
